# GeeksforGeeks

> > A comprehensive computer science portal providing tutorials, guides, and resources for programming languages, data structures, algorithms, web development, and emerging technologies.

GeeksforGeeks is one of the most popular educational platforms for computer science students and professionals, offering in-depth tutorials on programming languages (Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript), web technologies (HTML, CSS, React), data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas), and advanced topics like AI and machine learning. The site serves beginners through advanced developers with practical examples and structured learning paths.

## Key Topics

- Programming Languages (Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript)
- Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Web Development (HTML, CSS, React, PHP)
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- Data Science (NumPy, Pandas)
- Programming Fundamentals
- Client-Side and Server-Side Development
- Standard Template Library (STL)
- Java Virtual Machine (JVM)
- Beginner Programming Guides
- Web Structure and Markup Languages
- Hello World Programs
- Memory Management
- Django Framework

## Programming Languages

- [Programming Languages Tutorials - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/tutorials/programming-language-tutorials/): Central hub for programming language tutorials including C, C++, Java, Python
- [Python Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-programming-language-tutorial/): Python tutorial with NumPy, Pandas, Django for data science and web dev
- [Learn Python Basics - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-basics/): Python basics tutorial covering syntax, variables, and fundamental concepts
- [Java Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/java/): Complete Java tutorial covering OOP, JVM, and programming fundamentals
- [Introduction to Java - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/introduction-to-java/): Java introduction covering JVM, features, and Hello World programming basics
- [C Programming Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/c/c-programming-language/): C programming tutorial covering Dennis Ritchie's language and UNIX basics
- [C++ Programming Language - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/c-plus-plus/): C++ tutorial covering OOP, STL, and memory management fundamentals
- [JavaScript Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/javascript-tutorial/): JavaScript tutorial for client-side and server-side web development basics

## Web Development

- [HTML Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/html/html-tutorial/): Comprehensive HTML tutorial covering markup language basics and web structure

## Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

- [Artificial Intelligence Tutorial | AI Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/artificial-intelligence/artificial-intelligence/): AI tutorial covering machine learning, search algorithms, and generative AI
